subject: BrightMode — Post-call: Security scope, stakeholders & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@brightmode.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T15:02:00Z
Subject: BrightMode — Post-call: Security scope, stakeholders & next steps

Amanda — thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned:

Summary from call:
- BrightMode is exploring Redwood for low-latency customer support summarization and internal analytics (read-only inference).
- Primary constraints: SOC2 evidence, data retention & encryption, and procurement timelines tied to Q4 budget.

Immediate asks / actions:
1) Stakeholder map — who owns security, legal, and procurement on your side? (You mentioned Tom for procurement and internal security is Amanda — can you confirm names + emails?)
2) Security questionnaire — you mentioned sending your standard intake; please attach it and we’ll have our SE and compliance team start responses.
3) Systems in scope — you noted Slack + S3 ingestion + internal Postgres. Can you confirm exact accounts/buckets/names so we can scope data flow?
4) Kickoff call — propose a 30m security kickoff with Dev (SE) + our compliance rep to walk through the questionnaire and go/no-go criteria. Available windows below.

Proposed next steps (from us):
- I’ll share the call notes and a single doc with owners and timeline. [Attachment: post-call-notes.pdf]
- Dev will review your questionnaire once received and flag any technical clarifications.
- We’ll aim to return completed questionnaire + SOC2 evidence references within 4 business days after kickoff.

Availability for 30m kickoff (PT):
- Tue Aug 11: 10:00–11:30 or 15:00–16:00
- Wed Aug 12: 09:30–12:00

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
[Attachment: post-call-notes.pdf]

From: Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@brightmode.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Benson <tbenson@brightmode.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T09:18:00Z
Subject: Re: BrightMode — Post-call: Security scope, stakeholders & next steps

Thanks Marissa — great recap. Confirming owners and scope: 

Owners:
- Amanda Liu (me) — Head of Security & Compliance — amanda.liu@brightmode.com
- Tom Benson — Procurement lead — tbenson@brightmode.com
- Legal review will be handled by S. Patel (sent to you directly if needed)

Systems in scope (initial):
- Slack workspace: brightmode-prod (message history ingestion for summarization)
- S3 bucket: s3://brightmode-support-raw (attachments, transcripts)
- Postgres: internal-analytics-db (read-only replica)

I’m attaching our standard security intake spreadsheet — it has questions on encryption, data residency, personnel access, and compliance evidence. Please have your SE fill columns B–D where marked. [Attachment: security-questionnaire.xlsx]

Timeline: procurement aims to complete vendor evaluation by 2026-09-15 to meet our Q4 roll-out. We’d like the completed intake in ~5 business days after kickoff.

For kickoff, Tue Aug 11 at 15:00 PT works for us. Please send a calendar invite with a short agenda.

Thanks,
Amanda
Head of Security & Compliance
BrightMode, Inc.
[Attachment: security-questionnaire.xlsx]

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@brightmode.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T17:06:00Z
Subject: Re: BrightMode — Post-call: Security scope, stakeholders & next steps

Amanda — thanks for the questionnaire, I pulled the file and started reviewing. A few quick technical clarifications before the kickoff so we can make the session efficient:

1) Slack: what message retention window do you want to include? Full history or last 12 months? Also, do you plan to use a bot token for ingestion or export via Slack Enterprise export?
2) S3: can you confirm whether objects in s3://brightmode-support-raw are encrypted at rest with SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS and whether BrightMode will provide KMS keys or require us to use our KMS?
3) Postgres: is the read-only replica accessible over a private peering link or will we need a temporary SSH tunnel / bastion?

On evidence: our SOC2 report reference is SOC2-Type2-Redwood-2025.pdf (we’ll link to the excerpted controls you asked about in the Drive doc before the kickoff).

I’ll prepare a 20-minute technical section for the kickoff covering network architecture, token handling, and minimal-privilege ingestion patterns. If you can pre-fill the systems-in-scope CSV with exact bucket names and hostnames it will save time — I created a stub and attached it here. [Attachment: systems-in-scope.csv]

Looking forward to Tue 15:00 PT.

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com
[Attachment: systems-in-scope.csv]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@brightmode.com>, Tom Benson <tbenson@brightmode.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T10:12:00Z
Subject: Re: BrightMode — Post-call: Security scope, stakeholders & next steps

All — thanks, confirming kickoff: Tue Aug 11, 15:00 PT (30m). Calendar invite sent with Zoom link and agenda.

Agenda (short):
- 5m intros & timeline (Marissa)
- 20m technical + systems-in-scope walk-through (Dev)
- 5m procurement & next steps (Vivek)

Action owners after kickoff:
- Amanda: finalize and return security-questionnaire.xlsx (owners column)
- Tom: confirm procurement milestones and required PO/contract terms
- Dev: produce a short tech memo on ingestion patterns + SOC2 evidence pointers (within 48 hours)
- Marissa: consolidate owners + timeline in HubSpot and share Drive link to evidence pack

Attachments included here: post-call-notes.pdf, security-questionnaire.xlsx, systems-in-scope.csv (for pre-fill).

See you shortly.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
